title: 美联储主席：开场先谈徒步，政策内容何时登场？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I've been looking forward to this weekend, and before I go further, I want to thank Jeff Schmidt and his team for the incredible hospitality.
segments.zh: 我一直期待这个周末，在继续之前，我想感谢杰夫·施密特和他的团队的热情款待。

segments.en: Everybody here is in debt to you and your colleagues here at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City.
segments.zh: 在座的每个人都欠你和堪萨斯城联邦储备银行的同事们一份情。

segments.en: Our Jeff, our thanks to you and your team.
segments.zh: 杰夫，我们感谢你和你的团队。

segments.en: Now, he and the other planners here have some recreation options lined up for later today.
segments.zh: 现在，他和这里的其他策划者为今天晚些时候安排了一些休闲活动。

segments.en: I'd advise you to be very careful with your choices.
segments.zh: 我建议你在选择时要非常谨慎。

segments.en: As I learned years ago, you can take two different kinds of hikes on the trails around Jackson.
segments.zh: 多年前我就学到，在杰克逊周围的小径上，你可以进行两种不同的徒步。

segments.en: I can sum up my hikes with former vice chairman Don Cohn with two words I survived.
segments.zh: 我可以用两个词来总结我和前副主席唐·科恩的徒步经历：我活下来了。

segments.en: These steely marathon death marches reveal the sign of Don that I was not ready for.
segments.zh: 这些艰苦的马拉松式长途跋涉展现了唐的一面，我还没准备好。

segments.en: But there's another kind of hike. This one was with former chairman Ben Bernanke, another dear old colleague.
segments.zh: 但还有另一种徒步，这次是和前主席本·伯南克，另一位亲爱的老同事。

segments.en: With Ben, it was a much more leisurely pace, an easy stroll along the wandering trails of the Rockefeller Preserve.
segments.zh: 和本在一起，节奏要悠闲得多，沿着洛克菲勒保护区蜿蜒的小径轻松漫步。

segments.en: So before setting out today, my recommendation is to do a wellness check.
segments.zh: 所以，在开始今天的议程之前，我建议大家先做个健康检查。

segments.en: Ask yourself, is this a cone day or a Bernanke day?
segments.zh: 问问自己，今天是吃冰淇淋的日子，还是伯南克的日子？

segments.en: The best thing about this gathering is that it helps us all get out here to the mountains and clear our minds and think straight
segments.zh: 这次聚会最大的好处是，让我们都能来到山里，理清思绪，清醒思考。

segments.en: about our world and our time.
segments.zh: 关于我们的世界和我们的时代。
